purpose: Qualify shared source reader and reported transition grain; test declared aggregation candidates without fitting
dose_policy: DirectSpike numeric replicate prefix uses the separate N-column legend; hipMHC prefix must supply amol/fmol. Preserve the literal label and ordinal suffix; no physical specimen or file identity is inferred.
aggregation_candidates: sum all non-precursor transition areas for exact reported form and replicate
sum all transitions including precursor as a diagnostic control
missingness_policy: Count missing/zero/positive/invalid areas separately; a complete sum is unavailable if any included area is missing or invalid. Never replace missing with zero.
duplicate_policy: Report duplicate (peptide, modified form, replicate, precursor m/z+charge, product m/z+charge, fragment ion) keys; do not deduplicate or silently accept their sums as qualified.
S3_comparison: Compare all explicit replicate candidates at exactly matching modified form and dose against each previously verified source cell. Keep C/D/E ordinal-equals-replicate comparisons as diagnostics only; numerical agreement does not prove acquisition linkage.
numeric_diagnostics: Retain signed/absolute differences, exact equality, relative tolerance1e-6 and a conditional nearest-integer rounding bound0.5 per included integer-area row. The rounding rule is an assumption for diagnostics, not a source claim or admission gate.
